author: Spoookeh
body:
What do you guys think of this idea:
At the end of a nebula game, either in the chat section or right hand side of the screen your game stats would appear: kills, deaths, monuments broken etc. It would then disappear and reset for the next game. Please give this idea to mods and admins if you like it :)
